 #WePowerYourTalent
 The energy transition happens through people who see their role beyond tasks and understand that what they do has a real impact.
At PPC, we contribute every day to a safer and cleaner energy system, from the networks that connect communities, to renewable energy that transforms the energy mix, or solutions that make electric mobility accessible.
Regardless of the role, our contribution is reflected every day in the communities we serve, in the customers who choose us, and in an energy system that is constantly evolving. We are present across the entire energy value chain and we are looking for motivated people to join us.
If you are curious to understand things in depth, responsible for seeing them through to completion, and open to working in a continuously changing environment, then your place is with us.
 What You Will Do
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a purpose greater than daily tasks: making energy safer, more sustainable, and closer to people.
 We create the context for you to grow, being responsible for:
 Design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines and architectures to support business intelligence, analytics, and machine learning models.
 Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other engineers to ensure seamless integration of data across platforms.
 Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into scalable and efficient data solutions.
 Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment between engineering and business teams.
 Implement efficient data processing solutions, ensuring high performance and scalability.
 Optimize data storage, retrieval, and ETL processes to ensure data availability and integrity.
 Lead the design and development of cloud-based data solutions.
 Maintain version control and collaborate using GitLab to manage code and deployment pipelines.
 Develop and optimize SQL queries and integrate data from a variety of sources into central repositories (e.g., data lakes, data warehouses).
 Automate and streamline data pipeline processes with shell scripting and other relevant tools.
 Provide mentorship to junior data engineers, guiding them through technical challenges and helping them grow in their roles.
 Lead code reviews and ensure best practices are followed across the engineering team.
 Collaborate with data scientists / ML Engineers to ensure seamless integration of ML models into production environments.
 Collaborate with data analysts to confirm data validity.
 Implement best practices for model versioning, monitoring, and continuous deployment.

 We want you to join our journey with:

 Emerging Skills
 Modern Data Transformation / ELT Modelling
 What Will Help You Succeed
 Bachelor degree in STEM subjects (or working towards it).
 At least 1 year experience
 Experience in Data related roles or experience in data domain.
 Experience in SQL, including complex queries.
 Experience with Python for data engineering tasks, including building custom data processing solutions and automation.
 Hands-on experience with Apache Airflow for orchestration of data flows.
 Experience in using GitLab/GitHub for version control and CI/CD processes.
 Experience Docker and Kubernetes for containerization.
 Experience in Shell scripting (e.g. Bash).
 Experience in Cloud Provider.

 What Else You Should Know
 Recruitment process confidentiality
 At PPC, we respect the confidentiality of every application. Only selected candidates will be contacted for an interview, and all other applications will be stored in our database for a maximum of one year.
 About PPC
 We are leaders in energy in South-East Europe, active in electricity production, distribution, and supply, as well as in developing innovative solutions for a sustainable future. With an installed capacity of 12.4 GW, we supply energy to 8.7 million customers and deliver over 35 TWh annually.
In Romania, PPC became a top player following the acquisition of Enel companies in October 2023. With a history starting in 1950, we are listed on the Athens Stock Exchange and continuously expand our vision.
 Our commitment to diversity and inclusion
 We believe energy comes from people. At PPC, every voice matters, and diversity is the engine of our innovation. Regardless of age, ethnicity, gender, or disability, we offer an inclusive environment where you can grow and perform.
🔹 # EnergyForEveryone – for your career, for the future, for all.
